commands.command: targeted invitation-item/member store and HTTP tests with -race

verifiedBehavior: A 32-hex pending invitation ID resolves through the organization member-item detail route for owners/admins.
Pending details expose no fabricated user or teams and ordinary members receive 404.
Pending invitation role changes are rejected, while DELETE cancels the invitation and invalidates subsequent detail reads.
Existing active-member detail, role and team membership behavior remains unchanged.
